description: Phase 3-Soak primary metric. Drives the V3 success-metric assertion: a fresh `transport_module` published into the directory mid-soak is activatable on every platform stub (Linux + Android + iOS) within 24 simulated hours of bundle publication. Day 1 the rig seeds the baseline V3 family-mix directory. Day 7 a publisher emits `pickup-tm-v1` (a 3E hello-world module) into the subscription URL. Day 8 (24h later) the rig snapshots `engine_loaded_wasm_modules` on every platform stub and asserts `pickup-tm-v1` is present on Linux, Android, and iOS. Day 14 final ledger: cross_platform_pickup_pass = true. Locked at 3-Soak per `phases of development/27-phase-3-soak-success-metric.md` §6 primary; the rig's v3verifier walks the per-platform observation tuples and computes the aggregate.
